gaps.fact: Refosco dal Peduncolo Rosso, Friuli's native red named for its red stalk: dark, plummy, high in acid. Only the friuli article teaches it, and Refosco stands as a distractor in c-4sk3igue; no chapter fact and no keyed stem.

The Court's six DOCs: Alto Adige (Südtirol), Trentino and Valdadige; Friuli Isonzo, Friuli Colli Orientali and Friuli Grave. Valdadige appears nowhere in the Codex; Trentino DOC, Friuli Isonzo and Friuli Grave only in the articles; no stem asks which region holds which DOC, and no chapter names Alto Adige DOC as a denomination.
Conegliano Valdobbiadene Prosecco Superiore DOCG demands a higher minimum alcohol than Prosecco DOC. The Codex teaches its hills, Rive and Cartizze but never the alcohol step the Court names.

Secco and Amabile, the dry and medium sweet words on an Italian label. Only the italy article lists them; Amabile stands as a distractor in i-z8h6d1xc and i-soo2ytq5 and no stem keys either word (the same gap stands in the Lombardy and Emilia-Romagna review for Lambrusco).

Tiefenbrunner, Tommasi, Mionetto, La Marca, Zonin and Zardetto appear nowhere in the Codex; Movia only in the eastern-europe article; Cantina Terlano, Jermann, Livio Felluga, Bertani, Masi, Allegrini, Quintarelli and Bisol in the articles, Dal Forno in a Village chapter line. No stem of either bank keys any of the Court's northeast producers.

Many of Alto Adige's producers are co-operatives, which take in most of the province's grapes and make many of its best wines. Only the trentino-alto-adige article says so; no chapter fact, and the one stem that touches it (c-bkz54tln) leaves the co-operative unnamed in its explanation.

courtUpdates.printed: Trentino-Alto Adige: Alto-Adige (Südtiroler) DOC, Trentino DOC, Valdadige DOC; Friuli: Friuli Isonzo DOC, Friuli Colli Orientali DOC, Friuli Grave DOC
courtUpdates.now: Alto Adige DOC now carries 86 Unità Geografiche Aggiuntive, named sites approved by ministerial decree of 8 October 2024 (Gazzetta Ufficiale of 17 October 2024) and usable from the 2024 vintage: each admits one to five named grapes, takes fruit wholly from the site and cuts the yield by up to a quarter, and the label may add the UGA name to Alto Adige DOC. The trentino-alto-adige article already teaches it.
courtUpdates.source: Ministero dell'agricoltura, DM 8 October 2024, Gazzetta Ufficiale 17 October 2024; Consorzio Vini Alto Adige (suedtirolwein.com), the UGA classification; wineindustryadvisor.com, Alto Adige Wines announces a new UGA classification, 20 December 2024.

notes: Mapped questions: Régionale 61 (Italy), Village 62 (Italy North), 123 in all; both categories are shared with the other Italian subjects, and by stem the northeast share is 12 Régionale (i-iia5vdw1, i-rcthc70c, i-gx8tgo8t, i-hdg29imh, i-uspgul9m, i-wevkl8pm, i-kmkwyuhg, i-4e6dlcbc, i-fhhe23rx, i-se2jn3nn, i-epmuwmh0, i-g6vurspn) and 27 Village (15 Veneto, 6 Friuli, 6 Trentino-Alto Adige). Beyond the map: Dessert & Sweet Wines holds i-2hzipf62, i-9xte4r07 and i-7irscmb9; Sparkling/Fortified/Sweet i-1lbod8o6; Grapes & Labels i-canl2u60 (ramato Pinot Grigio), i-vs5chx3u (Garganega is Grecanico) and i-uex8a0g4 (Alto Adige and Südtirol); Italy Central & South c-lhywvj93 (Trebbiano di Soave). The Veneto half is the best served part of the Italian syllabus (the four Valpolicella wines, both Reciotos, Prosecco's ladder, Soave's hills); the Friuli and Trentino DOC list, Refosco and the producers are the thin cells. No factual error found: Valpolicella's blend (Corvina 45 to 95 per cent, Corvinone up to half of it, Rondinella 5 to 30), Amarone's 14 per cent and its January and November clocks, Ripasso DOC 2010, Amarone and Recioto della Valpolicella DOCG 2010, Recioto di Soave 1998, Soave's 33 UGA (2019), the 43 Rive, Cartizze's 107 hectares, Glera 2009, Prosecco Rosé 2020, Delle Venezie 2017, Trento DOC 1993 with 15, 24 and 36 months, the Friuli DOCG years (Ramandolo 2001, Picolit 2006, Rosazzo 2011) and Friulano's loss of Tocai in 2007 all hold. Court cells to read with care: the Court lists Schioppettino among Friuli's producers, though it is a grape (the Codex teaches it as one, c-mq61v321); Movia stands under Friuli but lies across the border in Slovenian Brda; it prints Veneto's climate as cool Mediterranean where the veneto article says warm continental on the plain, so a candidate should give the Court's category on the paper. Two searches spent: the Alto Adige UGAs (logged above) and the Amarone rules, where the consortium was weighing lower alcohol levels in March 2024 (ilpost.it) and no adopted change to the 14 per cent floor was found, so the Court's Amarone cell stands.
